prior_year_events.impact_description: Significant adverse development on the 2013 underwriting year observed in the claims development table (large increase between 'at end of year' and later development diagonals).
Minor favourable development on the aggregated 2010 & prior years (current estimate slightly below previous diagonal).
Releases observed for 2011 and 2012 in the development triangle.

named_events.loss_description: Listed in catastrophe exposure table as a material peril/driver of exposure

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2015 Syndicate 780 shows an opening gross claims outstanding (comparative 2014) of GBP 374.617m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle and the reserves movement table indicates a net adverse (strengthening) prior-year development of approximately GBP 35.1m (around 9.4% of opening reserves), driven primarily by adverse development on the 2013 underwriting year partially offset by releases on older years. Named catastrophe exposures (US/Florida windstorms, Los Angeles and Japan earthquakes) are presented in the catastrophe exposure tables and form part of the risk drivers; however the principal prior-year reserve movement appears related to large loss and claims development on earlier underwriting years.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Statement of Financial Position (liabilities) comparative 2014 column (page 14) and converted from GBP 000 to millions. Prior year development figure is estimated from the gross claims development triangle (page 27) by comparing the current diagonal to the previous diagonal for underwriting years <= 2013; no explicit single-line 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure was unambiguously located in the available images. As a result the prior year development amount is an approximation (confidence 0.5). The report contains a catastrophe exposure table (page 23) and multiple named event listings but net per-event losses are not quantified in the visible images. Gross premium segmentation (regulatory segmental analysis) could not be reliably extracted from the scanned images; gross premiums written total was taken from the Statement of Comprehensive Income (page 11). The claims development triangle is present but some cells/labels are partially obscured; numeric triangulation was inferred where clear and left null where not extractable.
